C. I've already posted a job opening.

items.question: We need to hire another graphic designer to keep up with demand.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“We need to hire another graphic designer to keep up with demand.”，自然应答是“I've already posted a job opening.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（I've already posted a job opening.）。
